technical.summary: Mixed micro-signals (supertrend, MACD bullish) conflict with macro bearish structure (price below all major moving averages, below cloud, weak ADX); insufficient confluence for high-probability swing entry.

fundamental.summary: ACN shows no insider buying conviction, no institutional accumulation signal, zero government contract activity, no lobbying engagement, and minimal retail interest; earnings in 39 days adds timing risk with no offsetting fundamental catalysts.

sentiment.summary: Mixed signals with minor congressional selling, broad market fear sentiment offering potential contrarian opportunity, but insufficient conviction and no news data to confirm setup.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: inverted yield curve signals recession risk, VIX at crisis levels (274.56) indicates extreme market stress; earnings in 39 days adds event risk; falling DXY provides minor relief for multinational ACN but insufficient to offset systemic risks.

debate.key_bull_argument: Supertrend, MACD, and EMA 9/21 bullish signals with price near support (243.23) offer micro-level reversal setup in fear-zone contrarian context.
debate.key_bear_argument: Macro structure is decisively bearish: price below all major moving averages and cloud, weak ADX trend, inverted yield curve, VIX crisis levels, earnings risk in 39 days, and zero fundamental/insider conviction create unacceptable risk/reward for swing entry.

decision.entry_rationale: Micro-level bullish confluence (supertrend, MACD, EMA 9/21) at support offers contrarian setup in fear zone; however, macro structure collapse and zero fundamental conviction make risk/reward unacceptable for new entry.
decision.primary_risk: Inverted yield curve + VIX crisis (274.56) + earnings in 39 days create systemic downside risk that overwhelms micro-bullish signals; price below all major moving averages signals structural weakness.
decision.recommended_exit: N/A — skip entry; if existing position held, use ATR trail 1x to protect against macro deterioration.
decision.agent_agreement: strong — all agents aligned on bearish macro dominance despite mixed technicals
decision.portfolio_note: Already holding ACN position + 1 other IT stock in 25-position portfolio; sector concentration and existing ticker exposure reduce conviction further; skip new entry to avoid over-concentration.
